summary: The candidate is a verified partial fix for the breakable prefill graph OOM-boundary capture path: its regression fails on the recorded base, passes at the exact candidate, and independent boundary checks confirm safe replay-grid pruning. It does not change or verify the separate Full-backend DFLASH state-index failure, and the reported CUDA/SM120/model stack was unavailable.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-92c3008dc27e/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner.py -k 'capture_stops_before_low_memory_bucket or capture_fails_cleanly_when_first_bucket_has_low_memory or capture_allows_exact_memory_boundary' (candidate tests temporarily applied to recorded base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: 2 failed and 1 passed. The base did not stop after free memory fell to 0.29 GiB and did not raise before the first low-memory bucket.
Passing-after focused suite: 13 tests and 7 subtests passed, including all three candidate memory-boundary regressions.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-92c3008dc27e/venv/bin/python - (independent mocked boundary and chunked-prefix assertions at exact candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: A 0.299999 GiB sample pruned the replay grid to the two completed buckets; a chunked-prefix bucket was retained only after all prefix variants returned.
One HIP graph FP32 matrix-multiplication smoke passed against a CPU reference; this measured only the available gfx950 graph runtime.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. The candidate's HIP graph numerical smoke passed, but no DFLASH/NVFP4 serving workload ran.
native_rebuild_reason: The candidate diff contains no C/C++/CUDA/HIP/native files; the reviewed change is Python-only.
remaining_counterexamples: The original --cuda-graph-backend-prefill full first-request path can still index state_indices_list[bs - 1]; the candidate does not change hybrid_linear_attn_backend.py or DFLASH padding/state-index construction.
The guard checks memory before a bucket, but the reported PyTorch 2.13 CUDA allocator/capture failure and the sufficiency of the fixed 0.3 GiB margin were not executable on gfx950 ROCm.
No end-to-end Qwen3.8 NVFP4 target plus DFlash2 draft request was run, so startup, first-request behavior, TTFT, acceptance length, and semantic output remain unverified.
remaining_limitations: Available architecture was AMD gfx950 ROCm, not RTX 5090 SM120 CUDA 13.
Available Torch was 2.11.0+rocm7.2, not the reported 2.13.0+cu130 allocator implementation.
The RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 target and incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 draft weights were unavailable.
The GPU smoke is unrelated to DFLASH, NVFP4, BCG allocator bookkeeping, Full-backend state indices, and model semantics.
No native rebuild was needed because there was no native source change.
